extracted.name: Gochujang sauce
extracted.description: If you like hot sauce, you won't be able to get enough of this gochujang sauce! It has an incredible sweet and spicy flavor that's delicious on bibimbap, roasted veggies, veggie burgers, and more.
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, whisk together the gochujang paste, vinegar, sesame oil, and maple syrup. Use less gochujang paste for a mild sauce, use more for a spicier sauce.
Spoon onto bibimbap bowls, or use as a dressing for any veggie rice bowl.
